text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Victory☆
The victorious Maya makes her grand triumphant return~!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe! Are you happy??
Did Maya's running make your heart pound??

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
But you know, Maya figured it out♪
If it's us, we can make it way more exciting!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
S-o-o!
You'd better brace yourself for the next race☆

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Kyaa☆ Trainer-chan, you're the best!
Maya feels the exact same way~!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: Listen, listen! In the final stretch... the winning post looked so sparkly and bright!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: Still... once I crossed the finish line, all the sparkle and excitement just vanished...

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
"And then I realized!
Maya can get way, way more hyped up!"

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
T-h-a-t-'s why! Trainer-chan,
I'm gonna keep your heart pounding way, waaaay more♪
